title: Inception
synopsis: A skilled thief who steals corporate secrets through dream-sharing technology is given the inverse task of planting an idea into the mind of a CEO while battling his own haunting memories.

title: Interstellar
synopsis: As Earth becomes uninhabitable, a former NASA pilot travels through a wormhole near Saturn in search of a new home for humanity while trying to keep a promise to his daughter.

title: Dark
synopsis: The disappearance of children in a small German town exposes the double lives and fractured relationships among four families across multiple generations tied to a sinister time-travel conspiracy.

title: Severance
synopsis: Employees at a mysterious corporation undergo a surgical procedure that separates their work memories from their personal memories, leading to unsettling discoveries about what they actually do.

title: Parasite
synopsis: Greed and class discrimination threaten the newly formed symbiotic relationship between a wealthy tech family and the destitute household infiltrating their lives one job at a time.

title: Crash Landing on You
synopsis: A South Korean heiress accidentally paraglides across the border into North Korea during a storm and is hidden and protected by an empathetic army officer who falls in love with her.

title: Goblin (Guardian: The Lonely and Great God)
synopsis: An immortal goblin seeking to end his cursed existence meets a cheerful high school student who can see ghosts and holds the destiny to end his centuries-long loneliness.

title: Shutter Island
synopsis: Two U.S. Marshals investigate the disappearance of a patient from a remote psychiatric hospital on an isolated island, uncovering disturbing secrets that blur reality and sanity.

title: The Social Network
synopsis: A Harvard computer science undergrad creates a social networking site that becomes a global phenomenon, sparking bitter lawsuits over betrayal, ownership, and ambition.

title: Silicon Valley
synopsis: A socially awkward programmer develops a revolutionary data compression algorithm and struggles to build a startup amid eccentric founders, ruthless VCs, and tech giants.

title: Arrival
synopsis: When mysterious spacecraft touch down across the globe, a linguistics professor is recruited to decode an alien language before global tensions escalate into war.

title: Whiplash
synopsis: A promising young jazz drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where an abusive, perfectionist instructor pushes him past every physical and mental limit.

title: Ex Machina
synopsis: A young programmer wins a week at the secluded estate of his tech company's reclusive CEO to administer the Turing test to an intelligent humanoid robot.

title: Her
synopsis: In a near-future Los Angeles, a lonely writer develops an unexpected and deeply emotional relationship with an advanced, self-evolving AI operating system.

title: Knives Out
synopsis: An eccentric detective investigates the suspicious death of a wealthy crime novelist, navigating a mansion full of greedy, lying family members.

title: 3 Idiots
synopsis: Two friends search for their long-lost college companion while recalling how his unconventional genius challenged the rigid pressures of India's top engineering institute.

title: Panchayat
synopsis: An engineering graduate reluctantly takes a low-paying government job as a village panchayat secretary in rural India while preparing for his MBA exams, slowly bonding with the quirky locals.

title: Steins;Gate
synopsis: An eccentric self-proclaimed mad scientist and his friends accidentally invent a device that sends text messages to the past, triggering devastating timeline shifts they must undo.

title: Death Note
synopsis: A brilliant high school student discovers a supernatural notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it, sparking a high-stakes intellectual duel with an enigmatic detective.

title: The Prestige
synopsis: In 1890s London, two rival stage magicians engage in a bitter, escalating battle to create the ultimate illusion, sacrificing everything in pursuit of secrecy and greatness.

title: Mr. Robot
synopsis: A socially anxious cybersecurity engineer and vigilante hacker is recruited by a mysterious anarchist to erase global consumer debt by taking down a corrupt mega-corporation.

title: Soul
synopsis: A middle-school jazz teacher gets the gig of a lifetime, only for an untimely accident to separate his soul from his body, forcing him to discover what truly makes life worth living.

title: Andhadhun
synopsis: A series of bizarre events turns the life of a piano player pretending to be blind upside down when he unwittingly becomes the sole witness to a murder.

title: The Secret Life of Walter Mitty
synopsis: A daydreaming photo editor steps out of his quiet routine and embarks on an extraordinary global adventure across Greenland and the Himalayas to track down a missing photograph.

title: Black Mirror
synopsis: An anthology series exploring a twisted, high-tech near-future where humanity's greatest technological innovations collide with its darkest instincts.
